claim: The Sun rises in the West.
speaker: anonymous
evidence_text:
[1] According to NASA, the Sun rises in the East and sets in the West due to Earth's west-to-east rotation.
[2] Multiple astronomical references confirm Earth rotates eastward, causing the Sun to appear to rise in the East from any non-polar location.
label: refuted

speaker: CFO of Company X
evidence_text:
[1] Company X's Q1+Q2 2023 reported revenue was up 50% year-over-year, per the earnings release.
[2] However, the audited annual report shows full-year 2023 revenue declined 5% vs 2022 due to a major H2 customer loss; the CFO's '50%' figure referred only to a single product line, not total revenue.
label: conflicting evidence/cherrypicking
